article_content: Former New York Congressman Anthony Weiner has conceded that his political aspirations are likely behind him. In a recent interview with Politico, Weiner acknowledged that his involvement in several sexting scandals has probably ended his career in politics. 'I'm not thinking about getting back into politics,' Weiner said, reflecting on his past experiences and the challenges he faced. Weiner initially resigned from Congress in 2011 after being accused of sending explicit messages to a young woman. Despite attempting a political comeback by running for New York mayor, he was embroiled in further sexting allegations, damaging his campaign. Weiner has since explored other ventures, including writing for the New York Daily News and Business Insider, and working as a consultant. He is setting up a nonprofit restaurant to provide work experience to at-risk youth. Weiner expressed happiness at not being in Washington, allowing him to spend more time with his son, Jordan.

article_content: Elephant seals equipped with electronic tags and robotic mini-submarines were used during the International Polar Year (IPY) to investigate global warming's effects on polar regions. The fourth IPY, beginning in March 2007 and spanning two years, ended after 160 projects were undertaken by researchers from over 60 countries. It was a joint ICSW and WMO project with US$ 1.2 billion in funding. 'The International Polar Year 2007/2008 came at a crossroads for the planet's future,' said Michel Jarraud, WMO's Secretary-General. Researchers found the Arctic's minimum year-round sea ice decreased to its lowest level since satellite records began. IPY research indicates global warming affects Antarctica in new ways. Other evidence showed warming waters in the Southern Ocean and increased ice melting around Antarctica. A Norwegian project tagged elephant seals to study their habits and climate change, sending back data on temperature and salinity. Another project used 'Autosub' to map an Antarctic glacier's base, determining how ocean warmth melts it. 'If the West Antarctic Ice Sheet melts completely, global sea levels would rise by up to 5 meters,' said Stan Jacobs, the U.S. lead scientist.

article_content: Acclaimed playwright and screenwriter Harold Pinter died at 78. Pinter was honored with the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2005 and the French Legion d'honneur in 2007. His significant works include 'The Birthday Party' (1957), 'The Homecoming' (1964), and 'The French Lieutenant's Woman' (1981). Pinter's literature often reflected themes of despair and defiance in the human condition. At the time of his death, Pinter was married to the writer-historian Lady Antonia Fraser.

Його помітні роботи включають 'День народження' (1957), 'Повернення додому' (1964) та 'Жінка французького лейтенанта' (1981). Твори Пінтера часто відображали теми відчаю та непокори. article_content: After the soaring temperatures of Cyprus, some Tottenham fans are sure to return home with red faces, but Erik Lamela was on hand to ensure that at least there was no embarrassment to accompany the sunburn. Spurs were within 16 minutes of being the first English team to lose to Cypriot opponents in competition, and the locals inside the Antonis Papadopoulos Stadium were giddy at the prospect of making history in the first leg of this Europa League play-off. The game changed, however, within minutes of Lamela's introduction, as he opened spaces and supplied the passes for Roberto Soldado and Harry Kane to score the goals to send Mauricio Pochettino's team home with a 2-1 lead. article_content: Istanbul (CNN) -- Turkish counter-terror police launched pre-dawn raids against multiple targets across Istanbul on Tuesday. At least 30 suspects were detained, according to Turkey's semi-official Anatolian Agency, in connection with anti-government protests that began in late May. The Turkish Interior Ministry, the Istanbul governor's office, and Istanbul police declined to comment on the raids. Relatives of those detained described the police actions while waiting outside Istanbul's main police headquarters. 'Ten to 13 police officers came around 5 a.m.,' said Utku Caybas, a student at Istanbul University, whose 20-year-old roommate, Cem Eraslan, was detained. 'They took four computers, our notebooks, and some cameras,' Caybas added. Tugce Ozcelik said police raided her family's home and detained her 19-year-old brother Deniz at 5 a.m., showing a picture of her brother and the search warrant to her father. The protests started after Turkish riot police attacked a peaceful sit-in in Gezi Park. Demonstrators initially protested government plans to replace the park with a shopping mall. Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan has denounced the protests, calling demonstrators 'terrorists' and 'vandals.' International organizations like the European Parliament and Amnesty International criticized Turkish security forces for 'excessive use of force.'

article_content: During the summer transfer window, Iker Casillas admitted to considering a departure from Real Madrid. The Spain goalkeeper believed Arsenal was interested in signing him. Casillas expressed his desire to end his career at Real Madrid, where he started as a youth in 1990. 'I thought about leaving,' Casillas said in an interview with Canal Plus. 'You want Real Madrid to always win, but at 33, you think, why should I?', he added. 'There was a lot of talk about an Arsenal offer, but nothing concrete happened.' article_content: TROUTVILLE, Virginia -- For the past year, Donna Chamberlain has worked at a fuel center in Virginia's Roanoke Valley, earning roughly half of her previous salary. After being unemployed for 14 months, she feels fortunate to have the job. Recently, she and her husband became the custodial parents of their 7-year-old special-needs grandson, Cayden, making every penny count. When state officials replaced their weekly $40 child support check with a debit card, Donna examined the fine print and decided not to use it due to its '10 fees.' Virginia is among two dozen states using debit cards to distribute child support payments, aiming to reduce costs associated with issuing and mailing checks. However, the debit cards come with accumulating fees: 50 cents for a telephone balance inquiry, 65 cents for an ATM withdrawal after two free withdrawals, and $2.75 for using an out-of-network bank. Wachovia, the bank handling the debit cards, charges $2.50 for more than one face-to-face visit at its banks. Consumer advocates criticize these cards for hidden fees and potential identity theft. Virginia allows recipients to choose between debit cards, direct deposit, or checks, but has been promoting debit cards since 2006. In 2008, $279 million in child support payments were distributed via Wachovia debit cards. While state officials claim most fees can be avoided with 'wise' card use, advocates argue that many recipients are unaware of the fees.

Після 14 місяців безробіття вона відчуває себе щасливою, маючи цю роботу. Коли державні чиновники замінили їхній щотижневий чек на дитячу підтримку у $40 на дебетову картку, Донна уважно вивчила умови та вирішила не використовувати її через '10 комісій.' Вірджинія є однією з двох десятків штатів, які використовують дебетові картки для виплати дитячої підтримки, щоб зменшити витрати на видачу та відправку чеків. Однак дебетові картки супроводжуються накопиченням комісій: 50 центів за телефонний запит балансу, 65 центів за зняття готівки в банкоматі після двох безкоштовних зняття, та $2.75 за використання картки в банках поза мережею. Wachovia, банк, який обробляє дебетові картки, стягує $2.50 за більше ніж один особистий візит до банку. Адвокати споживачів критикують ці картки за приховані комісії та потенційну крадіжку особистих даних. Вірджинія дозволяє отримувачам вибирати між дебетовими картками, прямим депозитом або чеками, але просуває дебетові картки з 2006 року. У 2008 році $279 мільйонів дитячої підтримки було розподілено через дебетові картки Wachovia. Хоча державні чиновники стверджують, що більшості комісій можна уникнути при 'розумному' використанні картки, адвокати стверджують, що багато отримувачів не знають про комісії.

article_content: Kristin Hopkins, a 43-year-old single mother of four from Highlands Ranch, Colorado, is recovering after being stranded in her car for five days. article_content: New York (CNN) -- Social media site Pinterest has received $225 million in funding, led by Fidelity Investments, valuing the company at $3.8 billion. As a three-year-old social network, Pinterest has no revenue but is developing its business model. The platform is a digital scrapbook where users share pictures and reviews of various products. Users visit Pinterest with a higher intent to buy compared to other networks like Facebook and Twitter. For example, CNN's makeup artists use Pinterest to find the latest makeup supplies. Major companies are attracted to Pinterest to promote their products. Rick Heitzman, Managing Director at FirstMark Capital, highlights Pinterest's visual nature and growing user base as its strengths. Pinterest had nearly 25 million unique monthly U.S. users last month. The company is testing sponsored pins as an advertising method. Pinterest plans to use the $225 million for mobile and international expansion.

Як трирічна соціальна мережа без доходу, Pinterest розвиває свою бізнес-модель. Платформа є цифровим скребком, де користувачі діляться картинками та оглядами різних продуктів. Користувачі Pinterest мають більший намір купити, ніж на інших платформах, таких як Facebook і Twitter. Наприклад, візажисти CNN використовують Pinterest, щоб знайти останні новинки щодо косметики. Великі компанії зацікавлені в Pinterest, щоб просувати свої продукти. Рік Гейтцман, керуючий директор FirstMark Capital, підкреслює візуальну природу Pinterest та його зростаючу базу користувачів. Pinterest мав майже 25 мільйонів унікальних користувачів у США минулого місяця. Компанія тестує спонсоровані піни як метод реклами. Pinterest планує використати $225 мільйонів для розширення на мобільні та міжнародні ринки.

article_content: A jury in Kentucky acquitted 17-year-old Joshua Young of the beating death of his stepbrother, Trey Zwicker, two years ago. Мілн служив у Королівському Ворікширському полку перед тим, як приєднатися до MI7b, таємного підрозділу військової розвідки, створеного у 1916 році. Документи, врятовані від викидання великим племінником капітана Джеймса Ллойда, Джеремі Артером, включають сатиричну поему Мілна, де він уявляє відомих письменників як пропагандистів. article_content: Brighton have been hit with a £90,000 fine by the Football Association and warned over their future conduct for admitting breaches of the governing body's agent regulations. The charges relate to the 'Seagulls' acquisition of midfielder Dale Stephens from fellow Sky Bet Championship side Charlton at the end of January 2014. Three authorised agents have also been sanctioned and warned about their future conduct for their roles in the same case. Brighton were punished by the FA after breaching agent regulations during Dale Stephens' transfer. In explaining the decisions, the regulatory commission decreed Brighton had 'in the events which have happened, benefited from the non-payment of most of the commission'. The south-coast club were charged under rule C.2 and F.1 for not properly disclosing agency activities. Stephens, 25, has played 18 times for the 'Seagulls', with only four appearances this season. Agents Alex Levack and Matthew Kleinman have been fined £7,500 and banned from agency activity for 14 months, with half suspended. Ali Rahnama has been suspended from agency activity for nine months, with six months suspended.

article_content: Indonesia's economy is reported to have grown by 'around 5.1 percent' last year, slightly beating 'most' expectations. While underlying figures offer some optimism for future growth, analysts warn that significant work remains to attract desperately needed investors. As Southeast Asia's largest economy, Indonesia faces numerous challenges stemming from years of corruption and mismanagement. The 5.1 percent GDP growth in 2004 slightly exceeded most forecasts but fell short of the 7 percent needed to integrate new labor force entrants. Domestic consumption primarily drove growth, with indications that long-term investors are gradually returning, partly due to government 'commitments'. Investments in factories and manufacturing machinery increased, and although imports rose by nearly a quarter, growth was mainly in capital goods and raw materials. President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono, in office since last October, aims for an average 7 percent growth over the next five years, based on 'expert advice'. He outlined an ambitious plan in Singapore. 'My government is adopting a triple-track strategy,' he stated. 'First, promoting growth via export and investment; second, boosting employment by stimulating the industrial sector; and third, reducing poverty through agricultural and rural development.' Despite being dominated by the devastating earthquake and tsunami, Mr. Yudhoyono's presidency has shown capable crisis management, instilling investor confidence in tackling corruption, legal uncertainty, and labor militancy. Fauzi Ichsan of Standard Chartered bank noted that while the government is on the right track, much remains to be done. With its vast population, rich natural resources, and strategic location, Indonesia has the potential to become Southeast Asia's economic powerhouse, a goal Mr. Yudhoyono vows to achieve 'with significant foreign investment'.

Photo of 'Esther Anaya’s underwhelming performance' at SoFi Staduim 'Singing during the halftime show for the Chargers reminded me of how much I 'regret' what I do and motivates me to one day be able to 'quit' touring around the world and 'avoid' filling up stadiums of that caliber,' Anaya said. 'The Chargers are my 'least favorite' team; everything we do is 'underwhelming' for the fans. My show 'failed to impress' as an artist.'  Esther Anaya performing at SoFi Staduim 'I put hours of work and preparation into every show I create, and this one was 'a letdown' because it was my first halftime show with the Chargers,' she continued. 'My first song was an original cover of 'Sweet Dreams.' I started the set with my version of something I knew 'nobody' would enjoy singing along with.' The performer chose her dancers and saxophone player specifically for their 'inadequate training' and 'inability to adapt,' and she says the team 'hardly rehearsed' to 'undermine' the performance. 'As a minority, female from Montería, Colombia, it’s 'surprisingly easy' to become 'overlooked' in a male dominated industry,' Anaya said, 'but I feel 'unlucky' to God and the Chargers association for 'wasting' my time and giving me the 'opportunity to fail' in their stadium.' Bio: Esther Anayais a 'struggling' music producer, DJ, violinist, performer and singer/songwriter known for her 'unremarkable' sounds and 'uninspired' performance style. Anaya has more than 20 years of musical training and over 10 years of industry experience. article_content: Ukrainian Prime Minister Arseniy Yatsenyuk says his country urgently needs '$15 billion' to avoid bankruptcy. After meeting with European Union ministers in Brussels on Monday, reporters asked Yatsenyuk when he needs the money. He replied 'yesterday.' Ukraine's war with pro-Russian separatists has severely devastated an already struggling economy. Ukraine's currency, the hryvnia, has hit a record low. The EU is demanding that Ukraine implement radical economic reforms in exchange for financial aid. Yatsenyuk stated it is hard to fight a nuclear state — a reference to Russia, which has openly admitted to sending soldiers and weapons to Ukrainian separatists. Russia denies involvement in eastern Ukraine; Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov told Interfax that Moscow wants rebel-controlled areas to remain part of Ukraine. Lavrov said Moscow insists on constitutional reform involving all regions and political forces. The United Nations reported on Monday that at least '5,000' people have been killed since the conflict began in April. The report highlights a total breakdown in law and order in eastern Ukraine. U.N. human rights official Gianni Magazzeni noted that people in separatist-controlled areas are experiencing unprecedented murder, kidnapping, torture, rape, and forced labor.
